## Summary

Describe the learner-visible change and why it belongs in Neihe.

## Validation

- [ ] `corepack pnpm run check`
- [ ] `corepack pnpm run skillhub:dry-run`
- [ ] Commits are signed off (DCO)

## Governance boundary

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, secrets, private logs, or learner data
- [ ] Provider APIs, CLIs, billing, quota, and usage attribution are unchanged or explained
- [ ] No unreviewed hosted or managed service behavior
- [ ] Official branding, release identity, and domains are unchanged or explained
- [ ] Version, publication surface, provenance, and SkillHub metadata remain aligned
